text: This solution, World Bank Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance Program (DRFI/DRFIP); Pacific Disaster Risk Financing and Insurance Program (Pacific DRFIP) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Papua New Guinea between World Bank Group, Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR), Secretariat of the Pacific Community (SPC/SOPAC), Government of Japan, ACP–EU Natural Disaster Risk Reduction Program, Risk modelers, Insurers, Reinsurers, and Investment banks. The program was implemented in 2013 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
